title: ec-jrc/lisflood-lisvap: LISVAP - evapotranspiration and evaporation pre-processor for the LISFLOOD model
description: LISVAP is a model that produces evaporation timeseries maps to be used as input to water balance/flood simulation models. Reference values for potential evapotranspiration and evaporation are estimated using the Penman-Monteith equation. It is part of the Lisflood Open Source model developed by the Joint Research Centre (JRC) of the European Commission.
